title: D-Wave Quantum Just Got a 240x Boost From AT&T. How to Play QBTS From Here.
excerpt: D-Wave’s 240x faster network optimization result with AT&T could strengthen the case for broader commercial adoption.
content_html:
Nauman Khan

Thu, August 6, 2026 at 7:31 AM MST 4 min read

D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) headed into earnings this week with something it badly needed: Evidence that its quantum-computing technology can solve real business problems. In late July, AT&T (T) expanded its use of D-Wave's quantum systems, highlighting a network-optimization project that went from roughly one hour to just 15 seconds.

That 240x speed-up is more than another quantum-computing headline. It gives D-Wave a tangible example of its technology delivering a practical result for a major telecommunications company. The bigger question for investors now is whether the AT&T relationship can translate into broader deployments and meaningful revenue as D-Wave reports its second-quarter results.

D-Wave Quantum Stock Has Cooled Down in 2026

Quantum computing stocks had a strong run last year, but the momentum has faded in 2026 as investors have become more cautious. QBTS stock is down about 25% year-to-date (YTD) as investors pull back from speculative tech names that are still burning cash.

Quantum computing stocks have been particularly volatile in 2026, as investors have struggled to assess how quickly the sector can convert technological breakthroughs into sustainable revenue. Although the AT&T news briefly sent QBTS stock higher, shares quickly gave back some of the gains. That reaction shows just how dependent the shares remain on individual headlines.

Yet investors are also paying a hefty premium for D-Wave's future growth. QBTS stock trades at roughly 6.5 times book value, slightly above other computer-hardware peers. The bigger valuation gap appears when looking at sales; D-Wave's price-to-sales (P/S) ratio is around 328.4 times.

AT&T Deal Gives D-Wave a Real-World Proof Point

AT&T is expanding its use of D-Wave's quantum annealing technology for network planning and optimization. The companies said a pilot project dramatically reduced the time needed to solve a network-optimization problem.

That matters because quantum computing remains an early-stage industry where investors are often forced to value companies based on future potential rather than current financial results.

AT&T plans to explore additional applications — including outage detection, fiber, and 5G planning — as network complexity increases alongside demand for AI and connectivity. The telecom giant is also testing D-Wave's gate-model systems for secure communications. That gives the partnership a broader scope than a single optimization project.

瑙曼汗

2026 年 8 月 6 日星期四上午 7:31（MST） 阅读 4 分钟

D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) 本周即将发布财报，带来了它急需的东西：有证据表明其量子计算技术可以解决实际的业务问题。 7 月下旬，AT&T (T) 扩大了 D-Wave 量子系统的使用，重点介绍了一个网络优化项目，该项目的时间从大约 1 小时缩短到仅 15 秒。

240 倍的加速不仅仅是另一个量子计算头条新闻。 它为 D-Wave 提供了一个切实的例子，说明其技术为一家大型电信公司提供了实际成果。 现在投资者面临的更大问题是，在 D-Wave 报告第二季度业绩时，与 AT&T 的关系能否转化为更广泛的部署和有意义的收入。

D-Wave 量子股票已于 2026 年降温

量子计算股票去年表现强劲，但随着投资者变得更加谨慎，这种势头在 2026 年有所减弱。 由于投资者从仍在烧钱的投机性科技公司撤资，QBTS 股价今年迄今已下跌约 25%。

2026 年，量子计算股票的波动尤其剧烈，因为投资者一直在努力评估该行业能够以多快的速度将技术突破转化为可持续收入。 尽管 AT&T 消息短暂推高 QBTS 股价，但股价很快回吐了部分涨幅。 这种反应表明股价对个别头条新闻的依赖程度。

然而，投资者也为 D-Wave 的未来增长付出了高昂的溢价。 QBTS 股票的交易价格约为账面价值的 6.5 倍，略高于其他计算机硬件同行。 从销售额来看，估值差距更大； D-Wave 的市销率 (P/S) 约为 328.4 倍。

AT&T 交易为 D-Wave 提供了现实世界的证明点

AT&T 正在扩大 D-Wave 量子退火技术在网络规划和优化中的使用。 两家公司表示，试点项目大大缩短了解决网络优化问题所需的时间。

这很重要，因为量子计算仍然是一个早期行业，投资者常常被迫根据未来潜力而不是当前财务业绩来评估公司。

随着网络复杂性随着人工智能和连接需求的增加而增加，AT&T 计划探索更多应用，包括断电检测、光纤和 5G 规划。 这家电信巨头还在测试 D-Wave 的安全通信门模型系统。 这使得合作伙伴关系的范围比单一优化项目更广泛。
